name: Cayey (Puerto Rico, United States)
description: Divided per saltire into white triangles at the top and bottom and red triangles at the hoist and fly, charged at the centre with the municipal arms in a white disc ringed in black reading CAYEY PUERTO RICO 1773.
history: Cayey is a mountain town and municipality in central Puerto Rico. The flag derives its design and colours from the coat of arms, adopted by the Municipal Assembly by ordinance No. 2 of the 1971–72 series on 15 June 1972.
